description: Roll an app back to a previous deploy (get the deployId from vibekit_list_deploys). The container restarts on the rolled-back build; reversible by rolling forward again.

deployId.description: Deploy ID to roll back to (from vibekit_list_deploys)

name: vibekit_rollback_deploy

outputSchema.description: Result envelope: ok=true with data on success, ok=false with error on failure.

data.description: Rollback confirmation for the selected deploy snapshot.

error.description: Error message when ok is false (e.g. missing/invalid VIBEKIT_API_KEY, or an API error).

title: VibeKit Rollback Deploy
